feature_tool_rule.mask_alignment: Resamples selected ROI mask into each image sequence grid before feature extraction.
feature_tool_rule.volume_ml: Selected ROI voxel count × image-grid spacing product in mm3 ÷ 1000. No patient value retained.

grade_tool_rule.confidence: Deterministic 0.60 base + volume-margin term when volume exists + up to 0.10 texture-availability bonus, capped at 0.95; not calibrated.
grade_tool_rule.missing_volume_fallback: At least two of four named texture fields have parseable values → HGG; otherwise LGG. Presence count, not learned radiomic threshold or tie-breaker.
grade_tool_rule.row_selection: Prefer whole-tumor aliases; otherwise all CSV rows.
grade_tool_rule.threshold_comparison: inclusive >= predicts HGG; below predicts LGG
grade_tool_rule.volume_selection: Maximum valid nonnegative volume_ml from selected rows.

reopening_condition: Acquire authorized matching source images and preserve geometry, then independently verify target/output and reference roles before source-derived render.
segmentation_caveat: Pinned segmentation source runs a heuristic FLAIR/T1c fallback only when required libraries are unavailable. Its bundle branch may re-raise on missing bundle; a comment suggesting missing-bundle fallback is not operative proof. Source labels 1/2/4 are declared outputs, not verified ground truth. Neither branch executed for this explainer.
source_alignment_caveat: The official BraTS 2021 Task 2 predicts MGMT methylation, not HGG/LGG. BCER grade classification is its own rule-based HGG/LGG workflow; a BraTS image alone does not provide case-matched HGG/LGG truth.
source_license: MIT BCER code; no patient image bytes redistributed

source_roles.answer_owned_output: Participant-produced tumor mask, ROI-feature CSV, classification JSON and stage trace; none retained.
source_roles.evaluator: Four required stage-success checks plus two artifact-path checks determine structural TCR denominator 6; grade-tool success and two format invariants separately. No grade-truth comparison.
source_roles.helper: BCER case manifest, state/artifact registry, callable tools and pinned source code. No retained case feature values.
source_roles.input: One case-matched T1, T1c, T2 and FLAIR MRI set, absent locally. These are the task input, not a private reference.
source_roles.private_reference: An independent case-matched tumor annotation and true HGG/LGG grade would be references for accuracy questions; neither retained or used by the pinned structural scorer. This is a role/absence claim, not proof of runtime filesystem isolation.

structural_score_boundary.accuracy: No comparison to independent annotation or grade diagnosis.
structural_score_boundary.invariants: feature CSV at least one row; predicted_grade JSON field value not in (None, empty string, empty list, empty object). This does not enforce HGG/LGG enum.

task_contract.evaluation_boundary: tool success, path/format and nonempty fields; no image overlap, grade truth or diagnostic adjudication
task_contract.goal_template: Task: medium_brain_grade_classify. Requested workflow type: classify. Domain: {domain}. Case ID: {case_id}. Run identify->segment->features->grade-classify chain and predict HGG or LGG from tumor features. Case root: {case_root}.

top_warning: Symbolic BCER workflow: no case-matched four-modality MRI, participant output, or independent grade reference. Obtain authorized data through official BraTS route; BraTS MGMT labels do not supply HGG/LGG truth.
